rules.statement: A plaintiff who was in possession of land and is proved to have been ousted by the defendant cannot rely on a third party having a superior title or on the defendant acquiring title after the commencement of the action.
rules.supporting_quote: "Where a plaintiff who was in possession of a land in claim is proved to have been ousted by the defendant, neither the fact that at the time of the ouster a third person had a title superior to that of the plaintiff, nor the fact that since the commencement of the action the defendant has acquired title to the land, is relevant on the question whether the ouster was justified."
